sections.executive_summary: IDF Brigade 401 achieved operational control in Khirbet Khadatha, southern Lebanon, eliminating over 20 Hezbollah operatives, destroying 90+ terror infrastructures, and capturing 150+ weapons including RPGs and anti-tank missiles. Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei's funeral drew massive crowds chanting anti-Trump slogans, with Yemeni participation and reports of Mojtaba Khamenei reappointing the judiciary chief. Netanyahu declared the Gaza threat removed while IDF operations continue in the enclave and Israeli civilians attempted unauthorized entry into Syria.

points: Massive funeral processions for Supreme Leader Khamenei filled Tehran's Enghelab Square with crowds chanting 'We don't want an agreement, we want Trump's head' and displaying banners vowing continued resistance and retribution (Source: @SharghDaily/170131, @rasedal3ado138e/374786, @rasedal3ado138e/374799).

Iranian civil defense reported no incidents during the funeral ceremonies attended by millions, including delegations from Yemen and senior advisor Mohammad Mokhber (Source: @naya_foriraq/81172, @naya_foriraq/81165, @rasedal3ado138e/374801).

Judiciary head Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei was reappointed for a new five-year term by Mojtaba Khamenei, described as the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic, signaling continuity in the judicial leadership (Source: @VahidOnline/76790).
Former presidents Rouhani, Zarif, Khatami, and Ahmadinejad notably absent from funeral prayers and ceremonies, highlighting internal political divisions (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74757).
Social media showed both regime supporters mourning and opponents celebrating abroad, reflecting deep societal polarization (Source: @kianmeli1/88347, @kianmeli1/88356, @kianmeli1/88357).

IDF Brigade 401 under Division 91 established operational control in Khirbet Khadatha, southern Lebanon, destroying over 90 Hezbollah terror infrastructures, killing more than 20 operatives, and seizing over 150 weapons including RPGs, anti-tank missiles, machine guns, and Kalashnikovs (Source: @idf_telegram/24532, @inon_yttach/9284).

Israeli civilians attempted to cross the border into Syria but were intercepted and detained by IDF forces, then handed to Israel Police; IDF condemned the attempt as a criminal offense endangering soldiers and civilians (Source: @New_security8200/202231).
IAF training exercises scheduled over Beersheba and western Negev from Monday to Thursday, with increased aircraft activity declared routine (Source: @idf_telegram/24530).

Netanyahu declared 'the threat from Gaza has been removed' while IDF activity continues in the enclave, with expected explosion noises in Eshkol region communities (Source: @pkpoi/143140, @New_security8200/202223).

Government approved statement to use all legal tools to overturn Supreme Court ruling; Netanyahu absent from meeting. Opposition leaders Eisenkot, Bennett, Lapid, and Golan warned of anarchism, breach of trust, and criminal governance (Source: @amitsegal/62755, @amitsegal/62776).

National Security Minister Ben-Gvir attacked Attorney General Baharav-Miara, vowing to complete judicial reform and accusing her of selective enforcement and undermining rule of law (Source: @amitsegal/62785).
Defense Minister Katz held working meeting with IAF Commander Maj. Gen. Omer Tishler (Source: @inon_yttach/9283).
IDF announced expected explosion noises in Eshkol Regional Council communities due to ongoing military activity in the Gaza Strip (Source: @New_security8200/202223).
Netanyahu stated 'the threat from Gaza has been removed' in a public message (Source: @pkpoi/143140).
Israeli police threw a stun grenade at a vehicle in Qalandia during daytime operations in the area (Source: @lelotsenzura/93350).
No specific casualty figures or detailed operational updates from Gaza or West Bank beyond these reports.

sections.threat_assessment: IDF's deepening operational control in southern Lebanon's Khirbet Khadatha demonstrates sustained pressure on Hezbollah's infrastructure, with significant weapons seizures and operative eliminations likely degrading immediate cross-border threat capacity. Simultaneously, Iran's leadership transition amid massive public displays of regime solidarity and anti-Western rhetoric signals potential for heightened proxy activation across the region. Israel's domestic constitutional crisis over judicial authority adds strategic unpredictability, while Netanyahu's declaration of removed Gaza threat may indicate shift to lower-intensity security operations. The convergence of Lebanese border operations, Iranian succession signaling, and Israeli political instability creates a multi-axis volatility requiring close monitoring of Hezbollah's reconstitution attempts and Iranian proxy directives.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese Army's controlled demolitions and public warnings reflect attempts to manage unexploded ordnance risks while avoiding escalation with Israel. Yemen's participation in Khamenei's funeral underscores Houthi alignment with Iran's regional axis. Turkey's hosting of Trump-al-Sharaa meeting indicates Ankara's mediation role in Syrian normalization. Gulf states' absence from visible diplomatic activity suggests cautious observation. The international community's focus on NATO summit sidelines may delay dedicated regional de-escalation mechanisms.
sections.intelligence_notes: The specificity of IDF's reported weapons cache (RPGs, ATGMs, Kalashnikovs) in Khirbet Khadatha suggests intelligence-driven targeting of Hezbollah's anti-armor and infantry capabilities. Mojtaba Khamenei's reported judicial appointment, if confirmed, signals hardline consolidation within Iran's power structure. Netanyahu's Gaza threat removal claim contradicts ongoing IDF activity reports, warranting scrutiny of operational definitions. The Israeli civilian border crossing attempt into Syria, while limited, reveals potential for unauthorized escalation triggers. Merchant ship attack near Hodeidah maintains Red Sea shipping risks despite reduced Houthi claims recently.
